request.scope: All21 existing published ALFRED series and all22 native factors, exhaustive independent online vintage-cutoff oracle, exact factor and daily row projection, eight fresh raw/calendar prefix rebuilds. Source-factor PIT evidence only; no question/world/eligibility/budget/scoring claim or protected-run/source rewrite.

online_cutoff_oracle.interval_rule: selected revision vintage < cutoff morning <= next revision vintage (if any); observation <= selected vintage < cutoff
online_cutoff_oracle.missing_policy: A missing revision withdraws that observation from the independent active-version ledger; no stale-value carry.

vintage_rule: Each scalar oracle cutoff consumes only groups with vintage_date < cutoff; observations newer than their vintage are ignored.
native_rule: Exact existing published grid and sampling, including calendar-month availability; no source/output rewrite.
